mapper.sql: BETWEEN (CAST(#{year} AS text)||'01') AND (CAST(#{year} AS text)||lpad(CAST(#{baseMonth} AS text),2,'0'))
mapper.select: SELECT h.DEV_ID AS "developerId",h.DEV_NM AS "developerName",h.BLNG_CLNT_ID AS "affiliationId", COALESCE(c.CLNT_NM,'') AS "affiliationName",h.JBPS_CD AS "positionCode", COALESCE(j.CODE_NM,'') AS "positionName",h.EMP_TYPE_CD AS "employeeTypeCode", COALESCE(e.CODE_NM,h.EMP_TYPE_CD) AS "employeeTypeName",h.JNCMP_DT AS "joinDate", h.RETIRE_DT AS "retireDate",h.JOB_CD AS "jobCode",COALESCE(b.CODE_NM,h.JOB_CD) AS "jobName", h.GRADE_CD AS "gradeCode",g.CODE_NM AS "gradeName",h.PART_ID AS "salesPartId", h.DRCT_CLS_CD AS "directClassCode" FROM TB_HR_DEV h LEFT JOIN TB_BS_CLNT c ON c.CLNT_ID=h.BLNG_CLNT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE j ON j.CODE_GRP_ID='JBPS' AND j.CODE=h.JBPS_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE e ON e.CODE_GRP_ID='EMP_TYPE' AND e.CODE=h.EMP_TYPE_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE b ON b.CODE_GRP_ID='JOB' AND b.CODE=h.JOB_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE g ON g.CODE_GRP_ID='GRADE' AND g.CODE=h.GRADE_CD WHERE (h.JNCMP_DT IS NULL OR h.JNCMP_DT < make_date(#{year},#{baseMonth},1)+interval '1 month') AND (h.RETIRE_DT IS NULL OR h.RETIRE_DT >= make_date(#{year},1,1)) AND position(lower(#{name}) in lower(h.DEV_NM)) > 0 AND h.EMP_TYPE_CD=#{employeeTypeCode} AND h.BLNG_CLNT_ID=#{affiliationId} AND h.PART_ID=#{salesPartId} AND h.JOB_CD=#{jobCode} ORDER BY h.DEV_NM,h.DEV_ID

SELECT p.PAY_YM AS "yearMonth",p.DEV_ID AS "developerId",p.EMP_TYPE_CD AS "employeeTypeCode", p.PAY_AMT AS "salary",p.ALWNC_AMT AS "allowance",p.INSR_CMPNY_AMT AS "companyInsurance", p.RETIRE_RSV_AMT AS "retirementReserve",p.INSR_SELF_AMT AS "personalInsurance", p.WTHLD_TAX_AMT AS "withholdingTax",p.INCM_TAX_AMT AS "incomeTax", p.REAL_PAY_AMT AS "netPay",p.VNDR_SPLY_AMT AS "vendorSupply" FROM TB_HR_MON_PAY p WHERE p.PAY_YM

SELECT s.DEV_ID AS "developerId",s.BGN_DT AS "startDate",s.END_DT AS "endDate" FROM TB_HR_DEV_STAT s WHERE s.WORK_STAT_CD='LEAVE' AND s.BGN_DT < make_date(#{year},#{baseMonth},1)+interval '1 month' AND (s.END_DT IS NULL OR s.END_DT >= make_date(#{year},1,1))

SELECT c.COST_YM AS "yearMonth",c.DEV_ID AS "developerId",c.PROJ_ID AS "projectId", c.ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId",COALESCE(p.PROJ_NM,'남는 몫(대기 원가)') AS "projectName", j.CODE_NM AS "jobName",c.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "contractTypeCode", c.ASGN_MM+c.FREE_MM AS "mm",c.SALES_AMT AS "revenue",c.LABOR_ALLOC_AMT AS "labor", c.TEAM_EXPS_AMT AS "team",c.PROJ_EXPS_AMT AS "expense" FROM TB_CO_MON_COST c LEFT JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=c.PROJ_ID LEFT JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN a ON a.ASGN_ID=c.ASGN_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE j ON j.CODE_GRP_ID='JOB' AND j.CODE=a.JOB_CD WHERE c.COST_YM ORDER BY c.COST_YM,c.DEV_ID,c.PROJ_ID,c.ASGN_ID

WITH months AS ( SELECT to_char(m,'YYYYMM') AS ym,m::date AS first_day,(m+interval '1 month-1 day')::date AS last_day FROM generate_series(make_date(#{year},1,1),make_date(#{year},#{baseMonth},1),interval '1 month') m ), inputs AS ( SELECT a.*,m.ym,m.first_day,m.last_day, COALESCE(n.MON_MM,round(COALESCE(h.NEW_CTRT_MM,a.CTRT_MM)* (LEAST(a.INPUT_END_DT,m.last_day)-GREATEST(a.INPUT_BGN_DT,m.first_day)+1) /extract(day from m.last_day),2)) AS mm, COALESCE(n.SALES_AMT,trunc(COALESCE(h.NEW_UPRC,a.BILL_UPRC,0)* round(COALESCE(h.NEW_CTRT_MM,a.CTRT_MM)* (LEAST(a.INPUT_END_DT,m.last_day)-GREATEST(a.INPUT_BGN_DT,m.first_day)+1) /extract(day from m.last_day),2))) AS revenue FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a JOIN months m ON a.INPUT_BGN_DT <= m.last_day AND a.INPUT_END_DT >= m.first_day LEFT JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN_MON n ON n.ASGN_ID=a.ASGN_ID AND n.INPUT_YM=m.ym LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT (SELECT x.NEW_CTRT_MM FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST x WHERE x.ASGN_ID=a.ASGN_ID AND x.APLY_DT <= m.last_day AND x.NEW_CTRT_MM IS NOT NULL ORDER BY x.APLY_DT DESC,x.HIST_SN DESC LIMIT 1) AS NEW_CTRT_MM, (SELECT x.NEW_UPRC FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST x WHERE x.ASGN_ID=a.ASGN_ID AND x.APLY_DT <= m.last_day AND x.NEW_UPRC IS NOT NULL ORDER BY x.APLY_DT DESC,x.HIST_SN DESC LIMIT 1) AS NEW_UPRC) h ON true WHERE a.ASGN_STAT_CD!='CNCL' ) SELECT a.ym AS "yearMonth",a.DEV_ID AS "developerId",a.PROJ_ID AS "projectId", a.ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId",p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName",j.CODE_NM AS "jobName", p.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "contractTypeCode",a.INPUT_TYPE_CD AS "inputTypeCode",a.mm AS "mm", a.revenue AS "revenue",p.TEAM_EXPS_AMT AS "team",p.PROJ_EXPS_AMT AS "expense", p.CTRT_AMT AS "contractAmount",p.BDGT_AMT AS "budget",d.amount AS "distribution" FROM inputs a JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=a.PROJ_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE j ON j.CODE_GRP_ID='JOB' AND j.CODE=a.JOB_CD LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sum(t.DSTRB_AMT) AS amount FROM TB_PJ_TK_DSTRB t WHERE t.PROJ_ID=a.PROJ_ID AND t.DEV_ID=a.DEV_ID AND t.DSTRB_YM=a.ym AND t.ROW_TYPE_CD='DEV' AND t.DSTRB_STEP_CD=(SELECT z.DSTRB_STEP_CD FROM TB_PJ_TK_DSTRB z JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.CODE_GRP_ID='DSTRB_STEP' AND c.CODE=z.DSTRB_STEP_CD WHERE z.PROJ_ID=a.PROJ_ID ORDER BY CASE c.CODE_NM WHEN '실제 투입계획' THEN 3 WHEN '최종 계약' THEN 2 WHEN '견적' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC LIMIT 1) ) d ON true WHERE a.mm > 0 ORDER BY a.ym,a.DEV_ID,a.PROJ_ID,a.ASGN_ID

SELECT c.CODE_GRP_ID AS "groupCode",c.CODE AS "code",c.CODE_NM AS "name",c.CODE_VAL AS "value" FROM TB_SY_CODE c WHERE c.USE_YN='Y' AND c.DEL_YN='N' UNION ALL SELECT 'affiliationId',c.CLNT_ID,c.CLNT_NM,NULL::numeric FROM TB_BS_CLNT c WHERE c.USE_YN='Y' UNION ALL SELECT 'salesPartId',p.PART_ID,p.PART_NM,NULL::numeric FROM TB_BS_PART p WHERE p.USE_YN='Y'

SELECT r.ROLE_ID AS "roleId",r.ROLE_NM AS "roleName",r.DATA_SCOPE_CD AS "dataScopeCd", r.SNSTV_VIEW_YN AS "snstvViewYn",r.USE_YN AS "useYn",r.SYS_ROLE_YN='Y' AS "basicRole" FROM TB_SY_ROLE r JOIN TB_SY_USER_ROLE u ON u.ROLE_ID=r.ROLE_ID WHERE u.USER_ID=#{userId} AND r.USE_YN='Y'
